items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I started out in Memphis, Tennessee, in high school under Jimmy Lansford's band

ctx.x: Do what you want to do.

Well, Stanley, I started out in Memphis, Tennessee, in high school under Jimmy Lansford's band, and I'm going back around about '28 and '29 now, and so we formed a little amateur high school orchestra, and so -- well, I just knew I was going (Inaudible), my mother, dad died when I was six, five or six. I was raised by my grandparents, who could neither read nor write. And she was the greatest midwife in the city of Memphis. She assisted in delivering more babies than any doctor in Memphis, white or colored, and…

Now, this woman was an amazing lady, without any formal education whatsoever, because she couldn't write, read nor write. My grandfather was the same a saint. They were the only parents I had besides an aunt, who's dead now, who lived across the street, and one of my grandfather's (inaudible).
